verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a commerce platform, but the evidence never documents a data-export feature or open export formats. The closest items are adjacent rather than a direct export capability: ownership of source code, open-source MIT modules, 'data sovereignty' and automatic backups. Under the partial-credit boundary these earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Own and control all your source-code, while we handle your infrastructure.
Medusa's core commerce modules are open-source and freely available on npm.
